name: slorb-rank-efficiency
origin: User hypothesis, verbatim: 'SLoRB's effect doesn't feel like it needs to be this big -- try a SMALLER SLoRB.' Tests whether SparseForge's 848,429,056-parameter low-rank bypass (26.2% of surviving weights, 13.1011 density points) is over-provisioned, using post-hoc surgery on an already-trained checkpoint so that NO TRAINING is required.
claim_under_test: The trained SLoRB branch of the SparseForge 5B headline checkpoint contains enough redundancy that a fraction of its parameters reproduces most of its union-9 contribution, moving the model to a better quality-vs-density point WITHOUT retraining.

kill_gate._preregistered: 2026-08-16, PRE-DATA. No rung has been evaluated. All constants below are frozen and were computed from evidence already on disk.
kill_gate.noise_floor_measured: 0.8953 pp = the widest paired-CI95 half-width among the three completed union-9 contrasts (0.7274 / 0.8123 / 0.8953), from paired item-level bootstrap within task, B=4000, seed 0, same resample applied to all cells simultaneously. Source: status/sparseforge_union9_closeout.json .deltas_union9_pp.
kill_gate.tau_derivation: tau = 2 x 0.8953 = 1.7906, rounded down to 1.79 pp.
kill_gate.tau_as_fraction_of_available_window: 33.4% -- the entire R0->R1 window is only 5.3657 pp (62.4335 - 57.0678), so tau consumes a third of it. This is why n=1-per-rung forces an explicit INDETERMINATE band rather than a binary read.
kill_gate.qualifying_rungs: psi >= 0.60, i.e. giving back at least 60% of the branch's 13.1011 density points: P (psi 0.6159), Q (0.6572), R (0.6869), S (0.7765). Rung A (psi 0.5229) does NOT qualify and cannot be used to support a rank claim.
kill_gate.clause_1_OVER_PROVISIONED: at least one qualifying rung scores >= 60.64.
kill_gate.clause_2_NOT_OVER_PROVISIONED: every qualifying rung loses more than tau AND the loss is monotone in psi.
kill_gate.clause_3_INDETERMINATE: a qualifying rung lands in the (1.79, 3.58) pp loss band. That is 1-2 CI widths at n=1 run per rung and MUST NOT be called either way.
kill_gate.clause_4_KILL_ON_PILOT: If PILOT rung P scores < 60.64, the cheapest step on the measured frontier has already failed and no deeper rung can succeed. STOP; do NOT launch Q/R/S. Cost to reach this verdict is 1.46 GPU-h.
kill_gate.clause_5_KILL_ON_CONTROL: If the density-matched SVD control Dctl scores >= rung P, the verdict is 'basis coarsening is the wrong operator', NOT 'SLoRB is over-provisioned'. Pre-registered because outputs/slorb_rank/op_matched_density_sample.json already shows SVD winning the density-matched W_eff comparison in 12/35 projections at c=4 and 24/35 at c=16, so Dctl is a genuine competitor and must not be described as a foregone loss.
kill_gate.clause_6_KILL_ON_RUNG_A: If rung A itself loses more than tau, even the parameter-free x_proj substitution is unaffordable, and the x_proj result in clause_7 is void as well.
kill_gate.clause_7_PREREGISTERED_THIRD_OUTCOME: Rung A passing while P/Q/R/S all fail is NOT 'over-provisioned rank'. It is 'x_proj is free, rank is not' -- 443,678,720 parameters deleted for a global W_eff perturbation of 12.3% of the delete-branch level. Recorded now, PRE-DATA, because the measured evidence (flat spectrum, exactly-1.0 on-block x_proj) makes it the likeliest outcome and it must not be reframed as a rank finding after the fact.

established_measurements._note: All values below were re-derived from source in this pass and reproduce the brief EXACTLY unless flagged as a CORRECTION.
established_measurements.branch_size: SLoRB_Weight 404,750,336 + x_proj 443,678,720 = 848,429,056 live params = 26.2% of the 3,238,002,688 surviving 2:4 weights = 13.1011 density points. Independently recomputed from measured shapes (32 layers x {q,k,v,o: W(4096,4096) r=256; gate,up: W(11008,4096) r=256; down: W(4096,11008) r=688}); scope 6,476,005,376 and surviving 3,238,002,688 also reproduce exactly.
established_measurements.rank_is_not_a_free_hyperparameter: r = in_features // SLoRB_k with SLoRB_k=16 MEASURED from the checkpoint's own args (SLoRB_k=16, SLoRB=true, SLoRB_init_type='sum', trainable_projection=true); sparse_modeling.py:415-427. Every projection is already at maximum rank for k=16. The ONLY knob the trainer exposes for 'a smaller SLoRB' is k.
established_measurements.spectrum_is_flat: Exact svdvals of E = SLoRB_Weight @ x_proj in float64 via QR of both factors (r x r core; the identity svdvals(S@B)==sqrt(k)*svdvals(S) holds to 1.5e-15, an independent check on the QR path). r90/r median 0.836. Versus a Gaussian product null of identical shapes, r90(measured)/r90(null) median 0.995 and >= 0.95 in 32/35 projections. Only L0.q_proj (0.400) and L0.k_proj (0.237) are genuinely concentrated. Source outputs/slorb_rank/slorb_rank_5b_headline.json.
established_measurements.block_structure_is_exact: x_proj on-block entries are EXACTLY 1.0 in 12/12 sampled projections (x_proj_on_block_min == max == 1.0, n_exactly_one == n_total), off-block meanabs 0.0030-0.0061. So x @ B^T is a segment-sum needing ZERO stored parameters -- that is where the 443,678,720 x_proj params go. Source outputs/slorb_rank/slorb_xproj_struct_5b.json.
established_measurements.global_perturbation_all_224_tensors: Exact, no sampling, from branch_importance_all224.json x global_operator_basis_all224.json: ||E||/||W_eff|| = 0.200010 for deleting the branch; blocksum with LS-refit coefficients = 0.024523 (12.26% of delete); blocksum with naive revert = 0.025603 (12.80%). The LS refit is 4.22% better and costs nothing, so the protocol uses LS.
established_measurements.svd_costs_more_than_no_reduction: Half-rank SVD stores both factors: (out+in)*r/2 summed over the model = 424,214,528 params, which is 4.81% MORE than the FULL-RANK blocksum branch at 404,750,336. Verified. This is why a naive t=r/2 SVD control is dominated on both axes and was replaced by a density-matched control.

corrections_to_the_brief.correction_3_svd_is_not_uniformly_the_we: outputs/slorb_rank/op_matched_density_sample.json already compares the two operators AT MATCHED PARAMETER BUDGET (svd_t chosen so (out+in)*t ~= out*r_eff; match verified to <2% on 160/175 cells). corrections_to_the_brief.correction_5_uniform_ladders_are_off_the: An exhaustive scan of all 5^7 = 78,125 coarsening maps over c in {1,2,4,8,16}, scoring global ||dW_eff||/||W_eff|| with per-family medians weighted by per-family ||W_eff||^2, shows the frontier contains NO uniform map above psi ~ 0.52. At psi >= 0.76 the uniform c=2 ladder costs 0.1423 where the frontier costs 0.1241 (+14.7% unnecessary damage); at psi >= 0.88 uniform c=4 costs 0.1734 vs 0.1623. The adopted ladder is asymmetric for this reason.

chosen_protocol_summary: BASIS COARSENING of x_proj with an LS refit, asymmetric per projection family. Three nested ops, all from the trained checkpoint, NO TRAINING: (1) blocksum-LS -- replace trained x_proj by its exact block-sum init B (sparse_modeling.py:883-886) and re-fit SLoRB_Weight by least squares in the new basis; x_proj becomes parameter-free. (2) coarsen -- additionally k -> k*c, exactly the branch that training with SLoRB_k = k*c would have used as a basis; LS-optimal coefficient for the coarser basis is the block MEAN of the c adjacent columns, NOT the sum (summing inflates scale by c). (3) asymmetric -- a different c per projection family, justified by measured per-family cost/damage: down_proj holds 22.28% of SLoRB_Weight yet has the LOWEST relE/W_eff (median 0.1546) and the lowest coarsening perturbation at every c, with o_proj next (0.1806).

ladder_frozen_20260816.hard_floor: No SLoRB rung can go below 50.0% -- that is pure 2:4 with zero branch.

must_not_claim: That a post-hoc truncation of a trained branch is a TRAINING-TIME rank ablation. Every rung is surgery on model_best_lm_eval.pt at iter_num 17900. A model trained from scratch with SLoRB_k=128 could reallocate capacity during training and land anywhere, plausibly BETTER than this ladder's rung at the same density. This experiment cannot bound that. The supportable claim is 'the trained branch contains this much extractable redundancy'; it may NEVER be phrased as 'SLoRB only needs rank r' or 'SparseForge should be trained with SLoRB_k = ...'.
That the 5.3657 pp window is 'the value of SLoRB'. It is folded-dense vs true-2:4. The honest variant-matched +/-SLoRB contrast is -2.4515 pp, i.e. +SLoRB is WORSE.

Any placement of any rung, or of R0, in a 2:4 column, table or sentence. All are folded and dense on disk (R0 linear_zero_ratio 1.08e-9). The existing bar at logs/sparseforge_tm_union9_slorb_progress.log:314 is ADVISORY ONLY with zero programmatic enforcement, so this is a human obligation.

That any rung is Pareto-superior to CAST-repro pure 2:4. CAST-repro scores 62.0919 at density EXACTLY 50.0% -- the hard floor, below every rung, and only 0.3415 pp under R0 itself. R0 with the entire branch and 13.1 extra density points beats it by less than tau. The Pareto claim is unreachable BY CONSTRUCTION.
frac_energy_from_learned_delta (<6%) reported as if it were a perturbation. It is squared; the relative error is ~13.7% median at branch level and 12.3%-of-delete at W_eff level.
That the spectrum of E is concentrated, or that SVD 'does not work'. Flat vs the null in 32/35, BUT SVD wins the density-matched W_eff comparison in 12/35 at c=4 and 24/35 at c=16.
That Dctl is a control expected to lose (see kill_gate.clause_5_KILL_ON_CONTROL).
Any rung reported as a measurement without stating n=1 and that tau is 33.4% of the entire available window.
That these rungs are 'what training with SLoRB_k = k*c would give'. The BASIS is identical; the COEFFICIENTS are an LS refit of a k=16-trained tensor, not trained in the coarse basis.
Anything about differential learning rates or node placement from the SparseForge trainer -- no training happens in B12 at all.
not_verified: No rung has been evaluated. Every union-9 number attributed to a rung in any future document must come from a run, not from the perturbation model in this file.
